## Problem and change

Explain the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link any related issue.

## Verification

List commands run and results. Include synthetic screenshots for UI changes.

## Compatibility and privacy

Call out schema/API changes, migration needs, and remaining limitations.

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and NOTICE.md, including contribution terms and third-party notices.
- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, personal data, private conversations, or hosting inventory.
- [ ] Relevant backend tests and frontend lint/build pass.
- [ ] Behavior changes have appropriate regression coverage or a documented manual check.
